# NotesHub

Two independent layers, unrelated to each other:

- **Sync layer** `src/sync-notes.sh` + `src/sources.*.conf` — rsyncs notes from external folders into the repo
- **Presentation layer** `src/www.py` + `src/www.conf` + the `notes-to-html` Skill — converts notes into HTML under `www/`

## Do not edit the markdown under the synced mirror folders

Those folders are whatever `dst` values the `src/sources.*.conf` files define — read them to see which directories they are in this repo. They are **read-only mirrors** synced in from external folders via `rsync -a --delete`. Editing them here will get them overwritten or deleted the next time `bash src/sync-notes.sh` runs. To change the content, edit the original source folder instead.

Exception: only touch them when the user explicitly says "this note has an error, please fix it for me," and remind them that the change will be overwritten by the next sync.

## Always go through the `notes-to-html` Skill when generating or updating pages under `www/`

Do not lay out pages yourself. That Skill carries the template skeleton, chart sizing rules, and a validator — pages produced by bypassing it will fail `validate_page.py`, and their style won't match the other pages.

The three rules most often violated (full details are in the Skill):

- **One `main` = one page** — don't merge multiple markdown files into a single page
- **Do not add, remove, or reorder headings** — carry the heading order and hierarchy of the `main` markdown file over as-is (headings inside the note, not the `[bracketed]` sections of `www.conf`), and only do visual translation. This constrains you, not the notes: when the note itself changes the page goes `STALE:src` and is regenerated
- **Never hand-write `www/manifest.json`** — it's generated by `python3 src/www.py commit`

## Check the status before making changes

```bash
python3 src/www.py status
```

`DIRTY` means the generated HTML was hand-edited afterward — stop and ask the user, don't just overwrite it.
`ORPHAN` and `MISSING:src` are report-only — don't delete files or edit the conf yourself.

For the full workflow and design decisions, see [README.md](README.md) and [docs/www-plan.md](docs/www-plan.md).
